edges.rationale: Frontend Developers are involved in the creation of web applications.
Azure DevOps is a common tool used by frontend developers for CI/CD and project management.
GitHub Actions is increasingly used for frontend deployments and testing.
Frontend development heavily relies on Agile methodologies for iterative development.
Understanding UX principles is a key requirement for creating user-friendly web applications.
